Executes bank microblocks and bundles, updates fees, rebates, metrics, and PoH mixins.

# Purpose
This file implements the `bank` tile for the runtime pipeline. It receives packed microblocks or bundles from the pack stage, executes each transaction against the bank state, updates compute-unit and rebate data, and publishes the processed output for the PoH stage. The code also builds the transaction hash mixin for each microblock, writes bank metrics, and sends rebate records on a separate output stream. The tile is set up as a `fd_topo_run_tile_t` named `bank`, so it is a runtime component that is loaded and run inside the larger system.

The main logic is split into fragment handlers and support code. [`before_frag`](<#before_frag>) filters incoming fragments, [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>) copies the incoming microblock into output memory and reads the bank trailer, and [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>) dispatches to [`handle_microblock`](<#handle_microblock>) or [`handle_bundle`](<#handle_bundle>). [`handle_microblock`](<#handle_microblock>) executes each transaction in order, finalizes successful transactions into the bank, computes actual and rebated compute units, and publishes a new microblock trailer with the transaction hash. [`handle_bundle`](<#handle_bundle>) applies similar work for bundles, but it treats the bundle as an all-or-nothing group and can publish several microblocks from one bundle. The file also defines scratch memory layout, seccomp and file-descriptor policy, and tile initialization for shared objects such as `fd_funk_t`, `fd_progcache_t`, `fd_txncache_t`, and `fd_banks_t`.
